简体中文: 在任意工作台使用能量节点，可升级工具、武器和装备。

English: Great work, Franco.   Be careful, he's been out a long time.
简体中文: 干得好，佛朗哥。小心，他已经昏迷很久了。

English: Franco?  Franco, what happened? Oh God… Isaac? Isaac Clarke!?  If you can hear me, run. RUN!
简体中文: 佛朗哥？佛朗哥，怎么了？天啊……艾萨克？艾萨克·克拉克！？听见的话，快跑。快跑！

English: Clarke!   Isaac Clarke, is that you?
简体中文: 克拉克！艾萨克·克拉克，是你吗？

English: My name is Daina.  I'm the one trying to rescue you…
简体中文: 我叫戴娜，是我在设法救你……

English: You're suffering from a unique form of dementia Isaac, something you contracted on Aegis VII.
简体中文: 艾萨克，你患上一种特殊的痴呆症，是在宙斯盾七号感染的。

English: Your dementia will kill you.  But if you can get here I can treat you and get you to safety.
简体中文: 痴呆症会要了你的命。但只要你能赶来，我就能治疗你，带你去安全的地方。

English: Because I'm not the one shooting at you.
简体中文: 因为朝你开枪的人不是我。

English: Just follow the route I'm sending you.
简体中文: 按照我发给你的路线走。

English: Isaac, what happened, are you alright?
简体中文: 艾萨克，怎么了？你没事吧？

English: If Tiedemann finds you, more people will die.
简体中文: 如果泰德曼找到你，还会死更多人。

English: Not if you follow my route.
You don't have to like it.   Just hurry, before you get locked in!
简体中文: 你可以不喜欢。赶在被关进去之前快走！

English: Well, try to break the glass with something in the room.
简体中文: 试试用房间里的东西打碎玻璃。

English: I told you to hurry!  How did you miss it?
简体中文: 我叫你快点！你怎么没赶上？

English: Fine! Let's see how long you last without it!
简体中文: 好啊！看你没我帮忙能活多久！

English: Look, Isaac, we don't have to be friends. But like it or not, we're stuck together.   Tiedemann's your enemy, not me.    Alright,  I've found you a new route.
简体中文: 听着，艾萨克，我们不一定要做朋友。但无论你愿不愿意，我们现在是一条船上的人。泰德曼才是你的敌人，我不是。好了，我给你找到新路线了。

English: You're on Titan Station, orbiting Saturn. As for the outbreak… shit, Tiedemann's jamming my signal…
简体中文: 你在环绕土星的泰坦空间站。至于这场感染……该死，泰德曼在干扰我的信号……

English: The ambulance bay is just ahead, you're almost out.
简体中文: 救护车停靠区就在前面，你快出去了。

English: Okay, the tram station is just beyond the apartment blocks.
简体中文: 好，穿过公寓楼就是电车站。

English: Three years.  Tiedemann found you floating in space near Aegis VII and brought you here for study.
简体中文: 三年。泰德曼在宙斯盾七号附近发现你漂浮在太空里，把你带来这里研究。

English: The Marker you found imprinted your brain with a self-replicating signal.  The longer you're awake, the more the signal spreads.  It's killing you Isaac.  Tiedemann tried to keep it in check with memory suppressants.
简体中文: 你发现的那座神印，在你的脑中刻下了会自我复制的信号。你清醒的时间越长，信号就蔓延得越广。它正在杀死你，艾萨克。泰德曼曾试图用记忆抑制剂控制它。

English: Only if you reach me in time. Tram Station.  Get moving.
简体中文: 前提是你及时赶到我这里。去电车站，快走。

English: You destroyed A Marker, Isaac. Tiedemann built another one.
简体中文: 你摧毁的是一个神印，艾萨克。泰德曼又造了一个。

English: It's powerful alien technology.  Tiedemann wants that power.  Get to the tram, it'll take you to the Cassini Towers Tram Station.
简体中文: 那是强大的外星科技。泰德曼想要那种力量。去搭电车，它会带你到卡西尼塔电车站。

English: What happened?  I thought we lost you!
简体中文: 怎么回事？我还以为失去你了！

English: How did you end up there? Hang on. This won't be the most pleasant route, but it'll get you to the Cassini Towers residential sector.   Dammit! Tiedemann has your signal again. Keep moving!
简体中文: 你怎么跑到那里去了？等一下。这条路走起来不会太舒服，但能到卡西尼塔住宅区。该死！泰德曼又追踪到你的信号了。继续走！

English: You're very important to them, Isaac…Hold tight, I'll contact you soon!
简体中文: 你对他们很重要，艾萨克……坚持住，我稍后联系你！

English: He's a psychopath Isaac, stay clear of him.  He murdered his own wife and child.
简体中文: 他是个精神病，艾萨克，离他远点。他杀了自己的妻子和孩子。

English: Yes.  There's an old maintenance access point in there that will take you through the waste disposal system and into the Cassini Towers.  Stay sharp.
简体中文: 对。里面有个旧维修入口，穿过废物处理系统，就能进入卡西尼塔。保持警惕。

English: Sorry Isaac.   You'll have to fly against the flow of the garbage upstream to get out.
简体中文: 抱歉，艾萨克。你得逆着垃圾流向往上飞，才能出去。

English: It's Tiedemann! He's found you! Into the Church, hurry!
简体中文: 是泰德曼！他找到你了！进教堂，快！

English: Isaac, my brother died trying to rescue you. This is important. This will work.  I'm in a safe room at the top of the Church. Meet me there, okay?
简体中文: 艾萨克，我哥哥为了救你死了。这件事很重要，计划一定能行。我在教堂顶层的安全室，到这里来找我，好吗？

English: It's one of the few places on Titan Station that Tiedemann can't monitor. Separation of Church and State.
简体中文: 这是泰坦空间站少数不受泰德曼监控的地方之一。政教分离。

English: Hang on, I'll try to override all the gates in the area.
简体中文: 等等，我试着覆盖这一带所有门禁。

English: Hurry. There's something out here, too…
You're almost here! I'll be waiting by the shuttle.
简体中文: 你快到了！我会在穿梭机旁等你。

English: Isaac, have you gone through a small circular door in the roof yet?
简体中文: 艾萨克，你穿过屋顶那扇小圆门了吗？

English: Be careful, you'll have to time it just right, it's only open for a split second after a coffin comes through.
简体中文: 小心，时机必须刚好。棺材通过后，门只会打开一瞬间。

English: They're Unitologists.  Everything everywhere is about coffins.
简体中文: 他们是统一教徒。走到哪儿都离不开棺材。

English: Is there a stasis module around there somewhere?  Try using one to slow down the door so you can get through.
简体中文: 附近有没有静滞模块？试着用它减缓门的速度，好让你通过。

English: Isaac, it's Daina.  You have to dismember the creatures to stop them.
简体中文: 艾萨克，我是戴娜。必须肢解那些怪物才能阻止它们。

English: Just try to stay in one piece.
Isaac, the people that ARE alive say they're using stasis to slow down the creatures!
简体中文: 艾萨克，还活着的人说，他们用静滞减缓怪物！

English: Isaac, I don't think I can…
Isaac, I can't unlock the elevator!  Can you do anything from your end?
简体中文: 艾萨克，我打不开电梯！你那边能想想办法吗？

English: Okay, once you're through you'll go through the Funerary wing of the church and down into the crypt. It's very important you're not …
简体中文: 好，穿过去后，你会经过教堂的殡葬区，然后下到墓室。你千万不能……

English: No! No, Earth Gov can't jam us in here! Not in here.
简体中文: 不！地球政府不可能干扰这里！这里不可能！

English: I don't know if you can hear me... You need... to go... up. Do you hear me? You need to go up.
简体中文: 不知道你能否听见……你得……往……上走。听见了吗？你得往上走。

English: Isaac? Dammit! I think they're jamming our signal with a mobile device. Someone get me the frequency on that jammer. They must have a gunship positioned near the compound!
简体中文: 艾萨克？该死！我想他们用移动设备干扰了我们的信号。谁去查出那台干扰器的频率！他们肯定在建筑群附近部署了一艘武装艇！

English: No, if they knew where we were, they'd have killed us by now. Shit! Signal's fading! Just follow your locator and hurry!
简体中文: 不，他们如果知道我们在哪儿，早就杀了我们。该死！信号在减弱！跟着定位器走，快！

English: Well, You didn't have a choice, Isaac. I told you there was a cure, and you came running.
简体中文: 你没得选，艾萨克。我说有解药，你就乖乖跑来了。

English: You're a dangerous secret, Isaac. Earth Gov won't leave you alone because they're afraid you'll destroy their Marker.\nAfter all, you did build it.
简体中文: 你是个危险的秘密，艾萨克。地球政府不会放过你，因为他们怕你毁掉他们的神印。\n毕竟，那可是你造的。

English: Well, that's why we brought you here. To build Markers for us. To spread glorious Convergence to the entire galaxy.
简体中文: 我们把你带来就是为了这个。替我们建造神印，让荣耀的聚合传遍整个银河。

English: Oh, we don't want to cure you, Isaac! We need that precious little head of yours just the way it is. Now would you escort Isaac to the shuttle and put him in stasis. The last thing we want is for him to die.
简体中文: 哦，我们可不想治好你，艾萨克！我们需要你这颗宝贵的小脑袋保持原样。现在，护送艾萨克去穿梭机，让他进入静滞状态。我们最不希望的就是他死掉。

English: Nolan Stross. He was a patient in the project just like you.
简体中文: 诺兰·斯特罗斯。他和你一样，是这个项目的病人。

English: Isaac, it's Daina.  My operatives are saying you have to dismember the creatures to stop them.
简体中文: 艾萨克，我是戴娜。我的行动人员说，必须肢解那些怪物才能阻止它们。

Well try to break the glass with something in the room.
简体中文: 试试用房间里的东西打碎玻璃。

简体中文: 附近有没有静滞模块？试着用它减缓门的速度，好让你通过。

English: Sorry Isaac.   You'll have to fly against the flow of the garbage upstream to get out.
简体中文: 抱歉，艾萨克。你得逆着垃圾流向往上飞，才能出去。

English: Isaac, have you gone through a small circular door in the roof yet?
简体中文: 艾萨克，你穿过屋顶那扇小圆门了吗？

简体中文: 小心，时机必须刚好。棺材通过后，门只会打开一瞬间。

简体中文: 他们是统一教徒。走到哪儿都离不开棺材。

English: You destroyed A Marker, Isaac. Tiedemann built another one.
简体中文: 你摧毁的是一个神印，艾萨克。泰德曼又造了一个。

English: Prevent Disc from being delivered to Intel Room
简体中文: 阻止将光盘送到情报室

English: Daina's on the opposite end of the Sprawl, and the fastest way across the station is the tram system. I need to get there before this chaos catches up with me.
简体中文: 戴娜在空间站另一端，最快横穿空间站的方式是电车系统。我得在这场混乱追上我之前赶到那里。

English: Well don't be shy about using it.   It will save your life.
简体中文: 那就别舍不得用，它能救你的命。

English:
Personal Log: Howard Phillips
Record number: 302

I want to go home.  ANTI claims she didn't get a response to my transfer request, but it's the FIFTH one.  How could there be five requests, and no response?  Surely someone is getting them?   Someone is reading them?

I hate to admit it, but the loneliness up here is really more intense than I expected.  I think it's starting to affect me.

The only good news is that ANTI claims to have authorized my shipment request.  They're supposed to be arriving later today.  But I can't believe anything she tells me.

I've been asking for so long, it's hard to believe they might actually let me have my birds.  Time will tell.  Tonight will tell, actually.

个人日志：霍华德·菲利普斯
记录编号：302

我想回家。ANTI说她没有收到调岗申请的回复，可那已经是第五份了。五份申请怎么可能一份都没回复？总该有人收到吧？总该有人在看吧？

虽然不愿承认，但这里的孤独感确实比我预想的强烈得多。我觉得它已经开始影响我了。

唯一的好消息是，ANTI说我的货运申请已经获批，东西应该今天晚些时候送到。可她说的话，我一句都不敢信。

我请求了这么久，很难相信他们真的会让我养鸟。时间会给出答案。确切地说，今晚就知道了。

English:
Personal Log: Howard Phillips
Record number: 466

I've been trying to stay out of range of ANTI's interfaces as much as I can.  I don't want to hear her excuses anymore about my transfer requests.  Every time I ask, I just get computerized bullshit.

Twenty-three requests!  I've put in twenty-three requests, and not one response.  I know she's lying, I know she never sent them.

I showed ANTI, though. I let all my birds out of their cages at lunch!  It was beautiful, they were all flying around, free and happy.   I wish I could be them.  ANTI was spouting regulations and talking about "abnormal profiles."   I didn't care.   I danced with the birds all day.  I love my birds. I want to go home.
简体中文:
个人日志：霍华德·菲利普斯
记录编号：466

我一直尽量避开ANTI的终端。我不想再听她拿调岗申请的事找借口了。每次问她，都只会得到一堆电脑生成的屁话。

二十三份申请！我提交了二十三份申请，连一份回复都没有。我知道她在撒谎，我知道她根本没发出去。

不过，我也给了ANTI点颜色看看。午饭时，我把所有鸟都放出了笼子！那场面真美，它们到处飞，自由又快乐。真希望我也能像它们一样。ANTI不停地念规章，说什么“异常行为特征”。我不在乎。我跟鸟儿们跳了一整天的舞。我爱我的鸟儿，我想回家。

English: Audiolog, RIG number 438642. I've been selected for a special secret mission, down in the core systems on the Shard. I hope I can do them proud. Altman be praised.
简体中文: 音频日志，RIG编号438642。我被选中执行一项特别秘密任务，地点在残片上的核心系统。我希望能让他们为我骄傲。赞美阿尔特曼。

English: Oh, God... I'm sorry. I didn't know what I was doing... I placed my faith in the Church and trusted them. What an idiot. Now there's something loose on the Sprawl, and the Church has abandoned me here!
简体中文: 哦，上帝……对不起。我不知道自己在做什么……我信奉教会，信任他们，真是个白痴。现在有东西逃进了空间站，教会却把我丢在这里不管！

English: Maybe I can make this right. Director Tiedemann asked me to repair the quarantine seal on Crossover Tube A. I don't know if I'll even make it there -- but it's my fault these things are loose in the first place. I have to try!
简体中文: 也许我能弥补这一切。泰德曼总监让我修复A号连接管的隔离密封。我甚至不知道自己能不能活着走到那里——可这些东西最初就是因为我才逃出来的。我必须试一试！

English: I'm almost at the Crossover Tube. If I can repair the seal, it'll stop the creatures from reaching the Public Sector. And then I'm going to tell everyone what the Church did!
简体中文: 我快到连接管了。如果我能修好密封，就能阻止那些怪物进入公共区。然后，我要告诉所有人教会干了什么！

English: Audiolog, RIG number 438642. These could be my last words. The monsters are loose. I couldn't stop them. And now the reactor core is overheating -- which will destroy the entire Sprawl if I can't fix it! So... I hope someone hears this. It means I did that much right, at least.
简体中文: 音频日志，RIG编号438642。这可能是我的遗言。怪物逃出来了，我没能阻止它们。现在反应堆核心又开始过热——如果我修不好，整个空间站都会被毁掉！所以……希望有人听到这段录音。那至少说明，有这么一件事我做对了。

简体中文: 加布·韦勒杀穿泰坦矿区，赶往医院与莱克辛·默多克会合，争取在为时已晚之前逃离。

English: Welcome to the Titan Station Church of Unitology!  We're glad you've come to visit our sanctuary, and place of light and hope.  Our tour guides are looking forward to showing you the best of our beliefs, and what a meaningful and enlightening impact we can have in your daily life.   There is of course no obligation of any kind with this tour.  Kindly remember to stay with your tour guide at all times. Someone will be with you shortly.
简体中文: 欢迎来到泰坦空间站统一教教会！很高兴你前来参观这座圣所，这片光明与希望之地。我们的导览员期待向你展示信仰中最美好的部分，以及我们如何为你的日常生活带来意义与启迪。当然，参加本次参观不附带任何义务。请记得始终跟随导览员，马上就会有人前来接待。

English: Welcome to the Church of Unitology gift shop!  Find that special souvenir for that special someone to let them know you stood in the shrine of Altman today!  Marker pendants made from the fragments of Titan itself are now available!   Altman be Praised.
简体中文: 欢迎来到统一教教会礼品店！挑选一份特别的纪念品，送给特别的人，让他们知道你今天曾驻足阿尔特曼的圣地！以土卫六碎片制成的神印吊坠现已发售！赞美阿尔特曼。

English: Behold the Church of Unitology reading room, a place of solace, a place of peace.  We invite you to sit by the hour and absorb the teachings of truth, unity and destiny.   Allow the comforts of the room to coddle your soul and soothe your weary spirit.  Maybe you too will can be lifted by the truths of Altman.  Only here, in the reading room of the Church.
简体中文: 请看，统一教教会阅览室，一处慰藉之所，一处宁静之地。我们邀请你在此静坐，细细领悟真理、合一与命运的教诲。让这里的舒适环境呵护你的灵魂，抚慰你疲惫的心灵。也许你也能从阿尔特曼的真理中获得升华。唯在此处，在教会阅览室。

English: In 2214, a geophysicist named Michael Altman made a discovery that would change history. Buried at the impact site of a crater near the Yucatan peninsula, he uncovered a divine alien presence - the Marker. The Marker spoke to Altman and revealed a plan that would unify mankind and lead them to a bright, new future.
简体中文: 2214年，一位名叫迈克尔·阿尔特曼的地球物理学家，做出了改变历史的发现。在尤卡坦半岛附近的一处撞击坑中，他挖掘出了埋藏的神圣外星造物——神印。神印向阿尔特曼传达启示，揭示了一项让人类合一、迈向光明新未来的计划。

English: By the millions, people flocked to hear more about the Marker and the unity it promised after Michael Altman told the world of his profound discovery.  But there were those who felt threatened by Altman's message. On March 15th  2215, Altman was assassinated and thus became the first Martyr for the church.
简体中文: 迈克尔·阿尔特曼向世界公布了这项意义深远的发现后，数百万人蜂拥而至，渴望了解神印及其许诺的合一。然而，有人将阿尔特曼的启示视为威胁。2215年3月15日，阿尔特曼遭到暗杀，由此成为教会第一位殉道者。

English: Altman's followers mourned his death but found divine solace in his message of unity.  They would not allow the truth to be silenced and formed the Church of Unitology to bring his teachings to the world.
简体中文: 阿尔特曼的追随者哀悼他的离世，却在他关于合一的启示中获得了神圣慰藉。他们不容真理被噤声，于是创立统一教教会，将他的教诲传遍世界。

English: Today the Church of Unitology can be found everywhere in the known Universe. Its message is just as strong and relevant today as it was when Altman first revealed it. Billions of believers can be found across all social, economic and cultural groups and more are joining every day.
简体中文: 如今，在已知宇宙的每个角落都能找到统一教教会。今天，它的启示依然如阿尔特曼初次揭示时那样有力而切合现实。数十亿信徒遍布各个社会、经济与文化群体，每天还有更多人加入。

English: Growing from a small group of devout miners on Titan, the Titan Station Church of Unitology has flourished into a hub of Unitology worship, practice and learning. It boasts one of the largest and most beautiful Churches in the Sol system and is often the site of the annual Unitology Enigma Symposium.
简体中文: 泰坦空间站统一教教会起源于土卫六上一小群虔诚矿工，如今已发展成为统一教礼拜、实践与学习的中心。它拥有太阳系内规模最大、最美丽的教堂之一，也是年度统一教谜阶研讨会的常设举办地。

English: As we await glorious Convergence, it is important to continue to nurture our relationship with the Marker and understand the future it is preparing for us. The Marker calls to all of us. It is our duty to approach it with an open heart and open mind.
简体中文: 在等待光荣的大融合之际，我们应当继续深化与神印的联系，理解它为我们准备的未来。神印在呼唤我们所有人。敞开心扉，以开放的思想走近它，是我们的职责。

English: Welcome to the Unity Hall. This magnificent library holds copies of the Church's most sacred texts and is a regular meeting place for the Unitology scholars as they debate the glorious mysteries of the Black Marker. Note the intricate details of the stained glass roof, forged from the hand-filtered sand of Titan itself!
简体中文: 欢迎来到合一厅。这座宏伟的图书馆收藏了教会最神圣典籍的抄本，也是统一教学者经常聚会、探讨黑色神印光荣奥秘的地方。请留意彩绘玻璃穹顶精巧的细节，它由人工筛选的土卫六砂粒熔制而成！

English: Welcome to the basilica!   This hauntingly beautiful hall serves as the starting point for many of our formal ceremonies.   Its architecture is rich in symbolism, and the stained glass ceilings are forged from no less than the sands of Jupiter's long lost moon, Io, making them nearly priceless.   Enjoy the light and the love this room offers, as many have done before you.
简体中文: 欢迎来到大殿！这座美得令人难忘的大厅，是我们许多正式仪式的起点。它的建筑富含象征意义，彩绘玻璃穹顶甚至采用早已消失的木卫一砂粒熔制，几乎是无价之宝。像无数前人一样，享受这间大厅给予的光与爱吧。

English: Welcome to the Sanctuary, the heart of the Church.    All our formal ceremonies and civil proceedings take place here, under the watchful, wise and loving eye of our founder, Michael Altman.   This room is an exact replica of the lost Church of the Pleiades.  Stardust from the supernovae that destroyed it is imbedded in the gold masks of the Enigmas.  Here, there is only truth.   Here, there is only Unity.   Here, we are all made whole.
简体中文: 欢迎来到圣所，教会的核心。我们所有正式仪式与民事典礼都在这里举行，接受创始人迈克尔·阿尔特曼睿智而慈爱的注视。这间大厅是失落的昴宿星团教堂的精确复制品。毁灭那座教堂的超新星留下的星尘，镶嵌在谜阶成员的黄金面具之中。在这里，唯有真理。在这里，唯有合一。在这里，我们终归完整。

English: Welcome to the Church of Unitology Gift Store!  Pickup beautiful miniature replicas of the black marker, or statues of the Enigmas with their inspiring, mysterious gold masks, or even a mask itself!  What truth will you see in them?   What truth will they see in you?   We offer use of the standard workbench for free, as well as a general store.    Thank you for visiting the Gift Shop!
简体中文: 欢迎来到统一教教会礼品店！选购精美的黑色神印微缩复制品，或是佩戴神秘而鼓舞人心的黄金面具的谜阶成员雕像，甚至可以买一副面具！你会在其中看见怎样的真理？它们又会在你身上看见怎样的真理？我们还提供免费标准工作台，以及日用品商店。感谢光临礼品店！

English: Welcome to the Titan Station Church of Unitology Library.    We have the largest collection of paper-style archives accessible to the public.   Most of these records were rescued from the Earth during the culture riots, and are now a priceless treasure of days past.  Some even date to before Michael Altman himself.   You will find extensive studies on the Black Marker from  Altman's own original transmissions, as well as forensic and other  well-documented evidence of the government's effort to cover it up.   Books may not be taken out of the Library, and please use your silence to respect those trying to study.     Thank you for visiting the Library, come back often!
简体中文: 欢迎来到泰坦空间站统一教教会图书馆。这里拥有向公众开放的最大规模纸质档案收藏。其中多数资料在文化暴乱期间从地球抢救出来，如今已成为昔日无价的珍宝。有些甚至早于迈克尔·阿尔特曼的时代。你可以找到以阿尔特曼原始广播为依据、针对黑色神印的广泛研究，以及证明政府掩盖真相的法证材料和其他详实证据。书籍不得带出图书馆，请保持安静，尊重正在学习的人。感谢参观图书馆，欢迎常来！

English: Welcome to Indoctrination. A church seminar is currently in progress. Please wait for the next available church associate. Indoctrination is a pleasant, joyous event, where you will take the first step into glorious oneness that is…Unitology.
简体中文: 欢迎参加入教讲习。教会研讨会正在进行，请等候下一位有空的教会同工。入教讲习轻松而愉快，在这里，你将迈出通往光荣合一的第一步，走进……统一教。

English: Attention:  Please be quiet when observing the funerary rituals of the church.  Flash photography and holographic imaging are not permited inside the Church.   Thank you for your compliance.
简体中文: 请注意：观摩教会殡葬仪式时，请保持安静。教会内部禁止使用闪光灯拍照及全息摄影。感谢配合。

English: Beyond these doors lies the Reading Room, a place where believers are encouraged to relax and meditate on the teachings of the Church. The shelves are lined with select inspirational materials as well as a variety of meditation aids. Please respect the sanctity of this space and those using it by remaining quiet and reverent while inside.
简体中文: 门后便是阅览室。我们鼓励信徒在此放松身心，冥想教会的教诲。书架上陈列着精选的启迪读物及各类冥想辅助用品。请保持安静与敬意，尊重这片神圣空间及在此修习的人。

English:
Chairman Donovan, this is Doctor Brooks. I've said this many times, and I'll say it again. I don't like the secrecy behind the new labs they've installed in the psych wing. It's been three years, and we don't have the faintest clue what's going on. Such secrecy has no place in an open and free society. Their networks are so isolated that we can't even tell they have one, let alone sift through it to see if anything unethical is taking place right under our noses.

If we don't get some traction on this soon, I'm going to go to Tiedemann, and insist on  formal review of these policies.

Brooks out.

如果这事很快还没有进展，我就去找泰德曼，坚持要求正式审查这些政策。

布鲁克斯，完毕。

English: Chairman Donovan, this is Doctor Brooks. I've said this many times, and I'll say it again.   I don't like the secrecy behind the new labs they've installed in the psych wing.    It's been three years, and we don't have the faintest clue what's going on.   Such secrecy has no place in an open and free society.  Their networks are so isolated that we can't even tell they have one, let alone sift through it to see if anything unethical is taking place right under our noses.  If we don't get some traction on this soon, I'm going to go to Tiedemann, and insist on  formal review of these policies. - Dr Brooks out.

English: The kids are playing way too rough on the playground! Yesterday, I literally had a line of students with scrapes and bruises going out my office door. A few kids sustained injuries bad enough to need to go to the infirmary. Call me old fashioned, but I think this is the problem with kids growing up on a space station. Kids need a planet with fresh air and open ground to play on. Otherwise, they go stir crazy and start picking on each other. Space is no place to raise a family, if you ask me.
简体中文: 孩子们在操场上玩得实在太野了！昨天，擦伤碰伤的学生直接从我办公室排到了门外。有几个孩子伤得很重，不得不送到医务室。你可以说我老派，但我觉得这就是孩子在空间站长大的问题。孩子们需要一颗行星，有新鲜空气，有开阔的场地可以玩耍。不然，他们就会被憋疯，开始互相欺负。要我说，太空根本就不适合养家育儿。

English: ISHIMURA RECOVERY INVESTIGATION:  \nReport 765-8 - It appears a group of asteroid belt scavengers were responsible for finding the Ishimura.  They boarded it shortly after its disappearance from Aegis VII.    Their RIG's were running a poor man's version of an encryption baffler, but the sync tracking system has a decypherable imprint.   "Benedykt Malyech" and a woman named "Jessica Li" were in the brig for some reason when their RIG's flatlined.  "Gatura Okeke" flatlined in the engine room.  As with the Ishimura crew, their DNA showed up in the "organic soup" we found covering those areas.  However, a "Stefan Schneider" made his way to the bridge, where he stole an EVA suit and spacewalked out of tracker range.  We do have them to thank for finding the Ishimura, to be sure.   Black box telemetry shows the Ishimura was violently catapulted out of orbit when the gravity web collapsed between it, the colony and the extracted continent it was carrying.   We may never have found it with no clue where to look.
简体中文: 石村号回收调查：\n报告765-8——看来是一群小行星带拾荒者发现了石村号。在它从宙斯盾七号消失不久后，他们就登上了船。他们的RIG运行着廉价版加密干扰程序，但同步追踪系统仍留下了可解密的记录。一个叫“贝内迪克特·马列赫”的人和一名叫“杰西卡·李”的女子，不知为何在禁闭室里失去了生命体征。“加图拉·奥凯克”则死于引擎室。与石村号船员一样，我们在那些区域发现的“有机浓汤”中检出了他们的DNA。不过，一名叫“斯特凡·施奈德”的人到达舰桥，偷走一套舱外活动服，随后通过太空行走脱离了追踪范围。能找到石村号，确实得感谢他们。黑匣子遥测显示，当石村号、殖民地及它所承载的开采大陆之间的重力网崩溃时，飞船被猛烈弹射出轨道。若没有任何搜索线索，我们可能永远也找不到它。

English:
TEXT MESSAGE
From: Sally Hennen
To: Marion Hennen

Marion, sorry I missed your call, I was busy at the Church thing I told you about. I know, I've been spending a lot of time with them, but I love it there. They're so welcoming and kind. They really like me. And they've invited me to become an Initiate! I think I'm going to do it. They've helped me see beyond our lives here in this universe, here in these bodies. There's a beautiful oneness waiting for us all, after this life of anger and sadness. and disappointment. There's a reading tonight at the Church sanctuary, so I may be there if you call. I hope to talk to you soon, and don't worry about those forms they sent you, I can explain. k, bye, love you!

Sally
简体中文:
文字消息
发件人：莎莉·亨嫩
收件人：玛丽昂·亨嫩

玛丽昂，抱歉没接到你的电话，我当时正忙着参加之前跟你说过的教会活动。我知道，我最近跟他们待在一起的时间很多，可我喜欢那里。他们特别热情，也特别友善，真的很喜欢我。他们还邀请我成为入教者！我想我会答应。他们让我看到了超越这个宇宙、超越这副肉身的生命。在这一生的愤怒、悲伤，还有失望之后，有一场美好的合一等待着我们所有人。今晚教会圣所有一场诵读会，你打电话时我可能会在那里。希望能早点跟你说上话。也别担心他们寄给你的那些表格，我可以解释。好了，再见，爱你！

莎莉
